articles.summary: Headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, Global Company Reaffirms Dedication to Community with Multi-Year Relief Pledge NEENAH, WI, August 11, 2026 — Plexus Corp. (NASDAQ: PLXS) today announced a $1 million commitment dedicated to supporting tornado relief and recovery efforts across Menasha and surrounding Fox Cities communities in Wisconsin.
